# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes target the latest released version of CrudCraft.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for suspected vulnerabilities.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting:

https://github.com/Data-Steel/CrudCraft/security/advisories/new

Include:

- affected CrudCraft version or commit
- affected module
- minimal reproduction details
- expected impact
- known workaround, if any

Maintainers should confirm receipt, triage impact, and coordinate disclosure before publishing details.
